notes.title: UI improvements
notes.content:
- rebalance: Surgery Mask: Health Regen 4 -> 5, cost 19 -> 25
- rebalance: Star Glasses: Range: 3 -> 0
- rebalance: Blue Cthulhu: Damage on contact: 2 -> 1, Health: 14 -> 12
- redesign: Weapon UI now displays love injection at the end of the description (sometimes it was confusing what love injection effect weapon had)
- redesign: Weapon UI now shows sell price when equipped'
- redesign: Weapon UI now shows type of weapon (Melee/Range) under the name of item
- redesign: Better Attributes description
- redesign: "Paw cooldown" Attribute name changed to "Paw cool off" (So that there is no confusion with weapon cooldown)

notes.title: Projectiles fix update
notes.content: BugFix: projectiles (all of them) are now frame independent

notes.title: 1.6.8 - new cats and items
notes.content:
Good news, everyone!  New patch for Cats vs Cthulhu is out and with it new cats and items. Tomorrow (05.01.2025) is the release on Steam. Wish me luck 😁

Enjoy new patch!❤️

- added: Cat: I51. Destroy enemies with the army of bots.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334061/215018e198b2dc2ba4bb861f8baf39762e8cfeca.gif

- added: Cat: Mummy. Scarab explosion.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334061/e42b41806450dafd240f34df93b69e57d355fe51.gif

- added: Cat: Vampire. Summon bats by healing yourself.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334061/d275edb181aea9578c8dcfdfdd3fb57b7d0f9830.gif

- added: Cat: Snake. The Healing Power of Rainbow Yarns.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334061/e31ac061543a92678fd09194fa1c677f60e48123.gif

- added: violet item Fish Release - unlockable by winning with I51

- added: violet item Pharaoh's Crown - unlockable by winning with Mummy

- added: blue item Top Hat - unlockable by winning with Vampire

- added: violet item Snake Necklace - unlockable by winning with Snake
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334061/850c0752e8756ed3de1e5d3ecb498d9c9781da86.png
 

Both versions:

- fixed: rainbow overlay (Rainbow power)

- fixed: sometimes a player could die and enter the shop at the same time


That's all for now. More updates are coming. More cats, more items, more maps, more improvements 😸⚔️🗺️⬆️ Stay tuned!

notes.title: 1.6.5 - Yarn Necklace and QOL
notes.content:
Good news, everyone!  New patch for Cats vs Cthulhu is out! It's mostly focused on QOL, but I also found some time to add a new item for yarn lovers🧶

Enjoy!❤️

You can wishlist game on Steam here

👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3270620/Cats_vs_Cthulhu/


Full version:

- added: white unique item: Yarn Necklace

(First unique common item. For each equipped yarn, creates a magical ball that flies around the cat and damages enemies for 2 damage.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45334061/aaedc4d4be1cb6a2fbf6d611587f2b696b904e1e.gif

Both versions:

- changed: item Going Dark is now available in demo version

- changed: glitter arena is now darker (I got feedback that many elements were not clearly visible in this arena. This should help.)

- changed: no more green blood from enemies (It didn't fit the game's theme)

- changed: Status from Green Yarn: Damage dealt to this enemy is increased by a certain percentage.

- changed: buff (15 damage -> 18 damage) for Rainbow Spirits

- changed: now damage received from enemies is delayed even more

- changed: cats Rocket Fuel and Well Fed are cheaper now

- changed: Desert Arena is cheaper now (1000 -> 300)

- added: ultrawide screen support

- added: info about starting attributes, items, special abilites of cat in pause menu


That's all for now. More updates are coming. More cats, more items, more maps, more improvements 😸⚔️🗺️⬆️ Stay tuned!
